title: Director Quality Management | Vertical Core Power
text:
Enjoy leading in an international, cross-functional setting and elevating quality in cutting-edge tech? Excellent—here’s your chance: as Director Quality Management in the Vertical Core Power Product Line, you’ll lead a global team and own product quality for modules for key Infineon AI customers.

Help shape the backbone of AI by delivering reliable, efficient power for hyperscale data centers—driving innovation in one of the most dynamic markets of our time.

Your role 
Key responsibilities in your new role

* + **Shape, manage and develop a global quality team for power modules that is equipped to define quality and reliability plans, technical problem solving and cross functional collaboration.**
 + Be responsible for Quality **Management of the power module lifecycle for products and technologies within a very dynamic product line.**
 + Define and maintain **quality targets (corporate and department targets) out of requirements from customer and market** for existing and planned future technologies, packages, products and services
 + **Define and deploy quality targets for power modules** based on customer, market and application requirements with a strong background in power module package and assembly.
 + Ensure the **fulfillment of time and cost according to agreed qualification plans** and schedules
 + **Develop strategy for product qualification that fit business needs and company quality brand**
 + **Participate in project board reviews and make decisions on project release**
 + **Lead the qualification strategy** along the whole value chain (in house, production partner, material supplier)
 + **Conduct risk assessments** and have decision competence on risk releases under time constraints
 + Initiate and drive **continuous improvement activities** and programs
 + **Act as an interface and build bridges across different functions** i.e. R&D, Marketing, Project management, and Quality Management
 + **Support customer** quality requirements and participate to discussion with key customers
 + Partner with technical teams and operations to **address quality escalations that could affect product quality or customers.**

Your profile 
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

 

* Achieved a **technical university degree** in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science or a comparable degree
* **10+ years of professional experience** ideallywithin the semiconductor industry, power module industry and **quality management**
* **Leadership capabilities,** +5 years of experience in leading global teams, taking full ownership and steering all parties towards common goals
* Experience with PCB **power module and module manufacturing**, and ODMs
* Advanced knowledge of **quality systems, methods, procedures and tools** (e.g. risk management, QFD, FMEA, 8D, JEDEC, AEC-Q, IPC standards etc.) and customer related processes
* In-depth knowledge of **semiconductor technologies, development and production** as well as of **logistics processes**
* Basic Knowledge of **audits, certifications, standards and process management**
* Experience in **customer communication and stakeholder management**
* **Flexibility regarding functional alignments across different continents**
* **Project Management experience** as a plus
* Experience in **power module and module manufacturing** as a plus
* **Fluent in English skills** – German or the willingness to learn it would be an additional plus

**Additional information**
